claim_tested: Quantify where suffix-aware repair helps, ties, or regresses under an independently sampled random-layout task generator, without selecting samples by observed method outcomes or an engineered coupling inequality.
evaluation_scope: simulation_only; constructed deterministic task contracts with independently sampled geometric primitives; descriptive under this generator, not an estimate of real-world mission prevalence.
sampling_unit: one independently seeded four-UAV task layout with the same fixed B2 partial-failure protocol and hard-contract semantics as the frozen three-way baseline

strata.coupling_strata: none; no coupling labels or bins are assigned

geometry_distribution.B3_cross_track_offset: independent sign with probability 0.5 times Uniform(0.5, 2.0) m
geometry_distribution.B4_cross_track_offset: independent sign with probability 0.5 times Uniform(0.5, 2.0) m
geometry_distribution.B1_local_start_xy: x Uniform(-3.0, -1.0) m and y Uniform(0.5, 2.5) m; independent
geometry_distribution.B2_local_start_xy: x Uniform(-0.35, 0.35) m and y negative Uniform(0.8, 1.4) m; midpoint is the exact half-vector
geometry_distribution.mechanism_bias: No parameter is derived from c2/c3 or h2/h3; no target coupling delta is imposed.

validity_rejection_rule.rule: Reject and redraw a layout only if any two consecutive waypoints in the declared B1->B2->B3->B4 execution/reference sequence are at most 4 times the fixed 0.10 m waypoint tolerance apart, or if schema/finite-value checks fail.

primary_outcomes.feasibility: recovery_success and strict_contract_satisfied, counting runner errors/missing rows as failures for denominators
primary_outcomes.executed_path: summed motor-executed repair-UAV path length; compare CDS-MR with immediate local only when both have strict success

paired_category.cds_benefit: CDS-MR alone has strict success, or both succeed and CDS-MR path is at least 1% shorter than the local path
paired_category.cds_regression: local alone has strict success, or both succeed and CDS-MR path is at least 1% longer than the local path
paired_category.practical_tie: both succeed and absolute relative path difference is less than 1%
paired_category.missing_or_invalid: technical row absent or invalid; keep visible and do not silently drop

analysis_plan.report: all 90 cases, counts and proportions for benefit/tie/regression/joint failure, per-structure counts, mean/median/standard deviation and paired differences; list every failed, timed-out, runner-error, and missing case.
analysis_plan.intervals: Wilson 95% intervals for categorical proportions; paired bootstrap 95% percentile intervals for continuous deltas using 10,000 resamples and analysis seed 20289999.
analysis_plan.local_edit_failure_regions: tabulate strict failures and failed contract checks by the preregistered dependency-structure stratum; no post-hoc geometry bins.
analysis_plan.cost: report solver-only and end-to-end failure-to-first-repair-command latency separately as mean, median, and paired difference.
analysis_plan.exploratory_geometry_analysis: Raw c2/c3/h2/h3 may be summarized continuously after the primary analysis; they must not redefine strata or sample membership.

execution.input_schema_and_runner: reuse the audited suffix-grid three-way runner and frozen comparison contract
execution.run_order: pilot on three disjoint seeds, inspect only protocol/runtime validity; then generate/freeze all 90 formal tasks and execute once
execution.preflight_failure_policy: If a code defect requires changing the generator or runner, preserve the failed pilot records, increment the B3 protocol/version, regenerate pilot with new disjoint seeds, and freeze a new formal input before execution.
execution.recovery_denominator: all 90 preregistered tasks per method, including runner errors and missing rows
